text.index.p.a-relaxed-little-studio-where-yo: A professional studio that doesn't cost $1000 a day.
text.index.h2.first-time-in-a-studio-here: First Time in a Studio? Here's how it works:
text.index.p.nobody-s-born-knowing-how-this: Recording in a studio is pretty daunting at first. Don't worry, it's a lot simpler than it looks!
text.index.p.no-rush-and-no-judgment-we: No rush and no judgment. We'll mess with sounds, experiment, and keep going until we have a sound you love.
text.index.p.we-mix-it-so-everything-sits: We apply the finishing touches to make sure everything sounds perfect, and then work on getting it published!
text.index.p.it-s-meant-to-feel-like: The Alcove is hands-down one of the most comfortable spaces in Provo. Take a Look!
text.index.p.there-s-real-gear-around-to: The room where it happens. This room can comfortably fit up to 5 musicians, and is where most work gets done. If you're a solo songwriter, or a 4-piece band, this is where the recording happens. When you book a session, you get full access to the great collection of instruments and gear that you need to make a great record. From an original golden-era custom OCDP drum kit, to a genuine Korg MS-20 synthesizer, you don't have to worry about the quality of your instrument- we have everything you'll need. Along with the great collection of instruments, there is also a great collection of gadgets, gizmos, and doohickeys to keep you inspired throughout the whole process. No matter where you look, theres always something to catch your eye and give you an idea for your next lyric. Creativity is something that's hard to control, so having a comfortable space is extremely important for recording.
text.index.p.it-feels-more-like-a-friend: This room is mainly used for live bands, choirs, string sections, and horn sections that call for a larger space to record effectively. It comes with great-sounding acoustics, a large floor space, and a Kawai grand piano to ensure that no project is too large to record.
text.index.p.i-m-here-to-help-you: Built in the 60's, the home of the Alcove is filled with character and wonder that is hard to find anywhere else.
text.index.p.all-kinds-of-music-all-kinds: Any type of business is welcome. We've recorded everything from pop musicians, to jazz quartets, and even podcast episodes.
text.index.p.you-don-t-need-any-experience: Don't feel rushed! When you're ready, go ahead and fill out the form and I'll get back to you ASAP.
text.about.p.hi-i-m-seth-i-make: It's important to research the studio before you book a session!
text.about.p.i-produce-record-and-mix-music: I'm the owner of the Alcove! I'm also the engineer you will be working with if you book a session. My goal is to make sure you are as comfortable as possible, and that everything goes smoothly and sounds great. I have tons of experience recording both professionals and total newbies- so no matter how skilled you are, I can guarantee that you will talk out of the studio with something you are proud of. I'm a skilled multi-instrumentalist, so I can easily fill in on other instruments when needed as well- so you can save money by not hiring a session musician. And in the rare case that a session musician is needed for a certain project, I have a large network of incredible musicians and producers who are ready to record whatever is needed.
text.about.p.i-care-more-about-how-a: I'm a Junior at Timpview High School. Along with running the Alcove, I also work as an Assistant Engineer at June Audio Recording Studios- a legendary world-class recording studio that has seen several famous clients, such as Post Malone, Benson Boone, The Killers, John Legend, iDKHOW, and many, many more. Working with such incredible engineers, artists, and musicians has taught me much of what I know today. In short, I know how to make a record sound professional-You're in good hands!
text.about.h4.what-i-believe: "Can I bring in my own engineer?"
text.about.p.making-music-should-be-fun-if: Of course! I'd be there to help the engineer get acclimated to the studio and make sure everything goes smoothly. Let me know if you'd like to bring someone in!
text.about.p.a-relaxed-open-room-where-you: I get a lot of unique requests for specific projects, and I'm always down for all of it! Here's what I specialize in:
text.about.p.this-is-where-the-playing-happen: I work as a professional musician around Utah. I play Drums, Keys, Trumpet, and Guitar!
text.about.p.a-spot-for-bandmates-friends-or: My main passion is studio engineering. I have lots of experience with lots of different clients!
text.about.p.where-we-listen-back-together-tw: When needed, I also help out with concerts, gigs, and other A/V needs. Let me know if you need my help!
text.about.p.patience-encouragement-and-no-eg: The last thing you need is an engineer that is hard to work with. Heres what I do to make your job easier:
text.about.h3.mentorship-not-gatekeeping: I'm not the artist, you are.
text.about.p.i-m-here-to-help-you: I'm here to record your music, not mine. I will help guide you along the process, but you will always retain full creative control. You deserve full ownership and royalties once the project is finished!
text.about.p.warm-up-experiment-and-mess-up: I will always be honest, no matter what. Whether I love it or hate it, I will always be clear and constructive with my opinions and ideas. You should always be proud of what you make!
text.about.h3.fair-for-student-artists: You need more than an engineer.
text.about.p.i-want-recording-to-be-within: You deserve an engineer who does more than just their job! I promise that I will always strive to be a friend of all my clients, and someone you can trust with more than just your music.
text.about.p.everything-people-usually-wonder: Lets get these out of the way so you aren't left wondering.
text.about.summary.do-i-need-to-be-totally: How good do I need to be to record?
text.about.summary.how-long-until-i-hear-the: How long does a session take?
text.about.p.not-at-all-rough-demos-and: If you're a solo artist looking to make a song from the ground up, then I can work with you no matter what. However, if you are a band or musician who is looking to record a pre-written song, make sure you are confident in your abilities before booking. The more takes we have to do, the longer the session will be- which is just going to make it more expensive for you. I don't want to empty your wallet! When you submit a demo, I will take a listen and let you know my thoughts before we book a session.
text.about.p.absolutely-there-s-room-for-band: Of course! Anyone is welcome- friends, family, session musicians, etc. Free of charge!
text.about.p.your-instrument-if-you-d-like: You only need to bring what we might not have here at the studio. If you prefer the sound of your guitar, or you really want a hydraulophone on your record, feel free to bring it!
text.about.p.we-ll-talk-timing-before-we: It depends on the session. Some projects are naturally more complex than others- and some ideas might take a while. We'll talk about timing when booking the session!
text.about.p.want-to-say-hi-ask-something: If you want to book a free studio tour beforehand, or just want to say hi, feel free to reach out!
text.contact.p.fill-out-whatever-you-know-rig: I'm excited to work with you! Just a few questions first:
text.contact.p.tell-me-what-you-re-working: Either fill out the form below to book a session, or check out my email below!
text.contact.p.i-ll-check-out-your-demo: I'll check out your demos, and make sure everything is in order. Should only take a day or two.
text.contact.p.a-relaxed-conversation-about-w: I'll reach out with the number or email provided, and we'll find a date to record or take a tour of the studio!
text.contact.p.we-pick-a-date-you-come: We spend the day recording your project! If we need more time, you can just text me for another session.
text.contact.p.prefer-to-skip-the-form-email: Have any questions? Don't hesitate to reach out!
text.contact.p.want-to-see-the-room-first: Want to check out the studio before your session? Or are you looking to get experience as an intern? Go ahead and send me an email! I'll get back to you ASAP.
text.work.p.a-few-things-made-at-alcove: Here's a few projects I have worked on at the Alcove!
